reason: I already take magnesium at night at home and have a drawer of half-used bottles, so the 'to go' part solves nothing for me. At $24.99 to $29.99 a month I'd just stay with my bottle and wait for a coupon on that.
objection: I don't need magnesium in a sachet when I take it at home anyway, and I'm paying extra for packaging I won't use.
would_change_my_mind: A per-day price clearly under what I pay for my current bottle, like a deep flash sale or coupon, and I'd probably try one box.
